release_notes: Standalone CineStream: the MovieIn companion is no longer bundled or auto-installed — the app plays straight from the webplayer extraction (Speedrace + providers) in the default CineStream player, with the optional MovieIN oracle used only when present. New Settings > Player toggle 'Auto-Extract from All Players' (ON keeps harvesting links from every player; OFF stops at the first playable link and resumes when you switch players).
